correctness.rationale: The graph is reconstructed from 15 nonzero F₂⁴ vectors and the 15 totally isotropic lines for a nondegenerate symplectic form. Its incidence graph has 30 vertices, degree 3, girth 8, diameter 4. Adams–Shukla–Singh Lemma 2.2 identifies N(T,4) with the downward closure of the 30 distance-2 neighborhoods (each size 10). Independent mask enumeration yields the exact f-vector (30,435,2620,5625,7290,6255,3600,1350,300,30), 27,535 nonempty faces, and a complete vertex-toggle matching of 13,695 disjoint Hasse pairs leaving exactly 1 vertex and 144 triangular 2-cells. Independently rebuilt all 144,210 oriented incidences and proved acyclicity by topological sort; Forman yields precisely a wedge of 144 two-spheres over Z. The pure 9-dimensional complex is not shellable because nonzero reduced H₂ lies below top dimension. Independent checks work only for this explicitly finite graph and claim no infinite-family generalization.
